name: Teen Volunteers, Plainsboro Township Recreation and Community Services
org: Plainsboro Township Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Help at big township events like Founders Day, Haunted Tonight and International Celebration. You can also run kids programs, clean trails and pack food pantry bags. Or be a Shadow Buddy for children with special needs.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be ages 14 and older. Teens who are younger than that cannot join.
duration: As needed; events are in early May, October and December
deadline_text: Volunteers are used as needed. No dates are posted for applying.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Volunteer Registration Form linked on the page.
notes: The township public safety page lists separate police volunteer options. The ages for those were not read.
